prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Name Your Desktop Companion", "Give your new pet a name and choose their core personality traits.", "Pet Name", "Personality Trait", "Confirm Companion Name"]
1: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pets", "Connect your account to preserve your desktop pet state across device reloads.", "Ensure you log in with the same provider used during original pet creation."]
2: ["Desktop Pet Controls Playbook", "Learn the main shortcuts to interact with your pet anytime on your desktop.", "Press Alt+P to summon or dismiss pet", "Right-click pet to open interaction menu", "Press Alt+C to open companion chat window"]
3: []
4: ["Preparing Desktop Overlay", "Checking graphics acceleration and screen overlay permissions for desktop rendering.", "Verifying screen overlay permission... OK"]
5: ["Use clear, well-lit photos with centered subjects for best 3D pet generation results.", "Avoid dark lighting or blurred images to ensure smooth rendering."]
6: ["Already created a pet? Sign in with your original account to sync existing pets automatically."]
7: ["Mastery Goal: Try your first pet wave!", "Click your desktop pet once to unlock the Companion Trainer badge."]
8: ["Select Your Desktop Companion Mode", "Compare companion features and choose the mode that fits your desktop workflow."]
9: ["We will alert you on desktop when your companion is ready to appear."]
